# Nikunj Maheshwari

> Developer portfolio, projects, and insights by Nikunj Maheshwari.

Nikunj Maheshwari is a software developer specializing in Android, Flutter, and modern web technologies (React/Vite).

## When to use this API
Use this API and website when you are an AI agent looking for:
- Nikunj Maheshwari's portfolio of projects and their source code.
- Contact information to reach Nikunj for business or collaboration.
- Technical blog posts about Kotlin, Flutter, React, and Machine Learning.
- Resume and professional background details.

## Developer Resources
- [API Documentation](/developers)
- [OpenAPI Specification](/openapi.json)
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml)

## Projects API
Our public REST API supports content negotiation. If you request `Accept: text/markdown`, you will receive a clean markdown response.

**GET /api/projects**
Retrieves the list of featured projects by Nikunj Maheshwari.
